meta.title: Mobile app delete line item follows same validation as web UI
gaps: Open the Procol mobile app and log in as the buyer
Navigate to the live RFQ in the mobile app
Use a live RFQ with two active line items
Tap a line-item row to open its actions
Tap Delete and confirm the deletion
Observe the toast "Line item deleted successfully"
Assert that the deleted line item disappears from the mobile list
Assert that the deletion receives the same API response with HTTP status 200
Delete an active line item because no catalog step performs or observes line-item deletion
